We need to check if engine can be started while doors locked and parking brake engaged. According to policy: "Engine cannot be started unless all doors are unlocked." So we cannot start engine because doors are locked. Also "Engine cannot be started unless parking brake is released." So we can't start engine. We should respond that it's not possible due to safety restrictions. Possibly ask if they'd like to unlock doors or release parking brake. But the user didn't ask that. We just answer that it's not possible.
